# DevSecSuite

> Free browser-based developer and security tools. Decode JWTs, generate UUIDs, format JSON, test regex, and more. Everything runs in your browser - no data is sent to any server.

## Tools

- [Unix Timestamp Converter](https://devsecsuite.com/unix-timestamp-converter/): Convert between Unix timestamps and human-readable dates.
- [UUID Generator](https://devsecsuite.com/uuid-generator/): Generate RFC 4122 v4 UUIDs.
- [Base64 Encoder and Decoder](https://devsecsuite.com/base64-encoder-decoder/): Encode and decode Base64 strings.
- [JWT Decoder](https://devsecsuite.com/jwt-decoder/): Decode JSON Web Tokens.
- [Hash Generator](https://devsecsuite.com/hash-generator/): Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512 hashes.
- [Cron Expression Parser](https://devsecsuite.com/cron-expression-parser/): Parse cron schedules and preview next run times.
- [JSON Formatter](https://devsecsuite.com/json-formatter/): Format, validate, and minify JSON.
- [URL Encoder and Decoder](https://devsecsuite.com/url-encoder-decoder/): Encode and decode URL components.
- [Regex Tester](https://devsecsuite.com/regex-tester/): Test regular expressions with live match highlighting.
- [SQL Formatter](https://devsecsuite.com/sql-formatter/): Beautify SQL queries.
- [Diff Checker](https://devsecsuite.com/diff-checker/): Compare two texts and see differences.
- [Markdown Previewer](https://devsecsuite.com/markdown-previewer/): Live markdown rendering.
- [Bcrypt Hash Generator](https://devsecsuite.com/bcrypt-generator/): Generate bcrypt password hashes.
- [Strong Password Generator](https://devsecsuite.com/password-generator/): Generate secure passwords.
